addManager.description: Grant an Atlas user Manager access to this academy — they'll be able to manage courses, instructors, content and academy settings, but not your organization's billing or subscription.

addInstructor.title: Add an Academy Instructor
addInstructor.description: Grant an Atlas user Instructor access to this academy — they'll be able to view their courses, students and submissions, and grade assignments, but not manage academy content or settings.

createStudent.description: Students aren't academy team members — this creates a brand-new Atlas account that can browse the course catalog and enroll, exactly like any other Atlas user.
createStudent.credentialsHint: Share these credentials with the student — they won't be shown again.

newAccount.description: Leave name and password blank if this person already has an Atlas account. Fill in both to create a new account for them.
